themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints exploded to 5 this week, up 1,900% from a 0.2-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.97), signaling either a sudden service failure or a new sanitation problem affecting multiple blocks in Flushing.
evidence: 5 street sweeping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.97)
Represents a statistically extreme spike with severity rating of 'high'
No prior baseline of street sweeping complaints suggests either new street conditions or service disruption
reporting_angles: Investigate whether DSNY reduced sweeping routes or frequency in Flushing this week; obtain service schedules
Walk affected blocks to document debris, dirt accumulation, and map which neighborhoods are worst-hit

themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 209 this week, up 326% from a 49-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 10.63), indicating widespread pavement, pothole, or sidewalk deterioration concentrated in this 7-day period.
evidence: 209 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 49-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.63)
Street condition is already a top-10 complaint category at 1,053 total over 90 days; this week represents a 4x surge
Community board has standing request for street/infrastructure investment, suggesting chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Obtain DOT pothole repair logs for Flushing this week; cross-reference complaint locations to identify geographic hotspot
Interview residents and business owners on specific streets with heavy complaints about safety hazards

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Spike
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints surged to 13 this week, up 512% from a 2.1-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 7.98), suggesting either an active infestation event, food waste mismanagement, or construction-related pest displacement in Flushing.
evidence: 13 rodent complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.98)
Converges with street sweeping crisis (5 complaints this week) and dirty condition complaints, suggesting overall sanitation breakdown
Heat/hot water at 2,080 complaints over 90 days remains top category; rodents often follow uncontrolled heating/cooling gaps in buildings
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Health Department for recent rodent inspection data and bait deployments in Flushing; determine if there's a known infestation zone
Investigate whether recent construction (1,004 permits filed over 90 days) has displaced rodent populations into residential/commercial areas

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 80 this week, up 316% from a 19.2-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 7.29), correlating with the spike in street sweeping and construction complaints, suggesting major infrastructure work or traffic disruption.
evidence: 80 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 19.2-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.29)
Converges with street condition (209 complaints), electrical (7 complaints), and street sign hazards (10 complaints), all spiking simultaneously this week
Residential noise remains a top-10 complaint at 1,639 over 90 days; street/sidewalk noise spike is distinct and acute
reporting_angles: Map this week's 80 noise complaints to identify if they cluster around specific streets; cross-reference with construction permits and DOT work orders
Contact 311 hotline supervisor and DOB to determine if major street/utility work was permitted or commenced this week without adequate notice

themes_detail.label: Electrical System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints spiked to 7 this week, up 522% from a 1.1-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 9.8), raising concerns about power outages, downed lines, or degraded infrastructure affecting homes and businesses.
evidence: 7 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.8)
Converges with street condition (209), traffic signal condition (131 complaints 2 weeks ago), and street sign hazards (10 complaints last week), suggesting systemic infrastructure breakdown
1,004 DOB permits over 90 days may indicate underground utility disruptions during excavation or renovation work
reporting_angles: Contact Con Edison for outage reports and equipment failures in Flushing this week; determine if there's a downed main or transformer issue
Cross-reference electrical complaints with recent street/sidewalk work permits to identify if utility lines were damaged during construction
